targets.old_statement: Stops halt fully with all-way order by arrival, yields slow through clear gaps, and entry bans reverse at once.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Stops halt fully with all-way order by arrival, yields slow through clear gaps, and entry bans reverse at once.
targets.statement: Stop signs require a complete halt with all-way stops proceeding by arrival order and right-side yield on ties, Yield requires slowing and giving crossing traffic right-of-way without stopping if clear, Do Not Enter bars entry, and Wrong Way orders an immediate turnaround.

targets.old_statement: Speed plates cap roads, exit plates cap ramps, and zone plates double fines under lights.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Speed plates cap roads, exit plates cap ramps, and zone plates double fines under lights.
targets.statement: Speed Limit signs post the maximum lawful road speed, Exit Speed signs give the fastest safe speed for an expressway exit ramp, and Speeding Fines Doubled signs warn that speeding fines double in active school and work zones.

targets.old_statement: Low spans refuse tall rigs, slick and soft ground slows all, narrow bridges hold lanes, and one-lane spans alternate.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Low spans refuse tall rigs, slick and soft ground slows all, narrow bridges hold lanes, and one-lane spans alternate.
targets.statement: Low Clearance bars vehicles taller than the posted height, Slippery Surface warns to drive slowly in wet weather without sudden acceleration, quick braking, or fast turns, Soft Shoulder warns not to leave the pavement except in an emergency, Narrow Bridge requires staying in your lane, and One Lane Bridge allows one vehicle at a time once clear of oncoming traffic.

targets.old_statement: Crossers clear all tracks with room beyond and never race trains, trailing buses that always stop.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Crossers clear all tracks with room beyond and never race trains, trailing buses that always stop.
targets.statement: Before crossing railroad tracks, ensure every track is clear with room for your vehicle on the far side, never try to beat a train, and stay ready to stop behind buses or trucks because many must stop at crossings even when gates are up and lights are off.
